list.name: client_platform
list.label: 客户端平台
list.query: WebGL : webgl,Windows Player : windows,Unity Editor : editor,其他客户端 : other,未知/历史未上报 : unknown,无客户端归属 : unattributed

list.name: distribution_channel
list.label: 发行渠道
list.query: 内部版 : internal,Steam : steam,TapTap : taptap,网页版 : web,未知／历史未上报 : unknown

list.name: release_version
list.label: 发布版本
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(release_version,''),'__empty__') AS __text,COALESCE(NULLIF(release_version,''),'__empty__') AS __value FROM analytics_sessions ORDER BY 1 DESC

list.name: playtest_id
list.label: Playtest 批次
list.query: 全部 : all,中秋playtest : 中秋playtest,历史／未标记 : legacy

list.name: test_data
list.label: 测试数据
list.query: 按平台自动 : auto,排除 : exclude,包含 : include,仅测试 : only

list.name: module_guided
list.label: 新手引导中的操作
list.query: 去掉引导 : exclude,包含引导 : include

      acts AS (SELECT * FROM m WHERE is_player=1 AND COALESCE(source,'player') NOT IN ('cat','system','automatic','server_playback') AND event_type NOT IN ('offer_shown','currency_delta','ui_view_opened','ui_view_closed','feature_entry_exposed','theater_line','theater_view','restaurant_guest_ordered','restaurant_guest_left_angry','mail_arrived','visitor_wishes_appeared','restaurant_session_ended') AND ('${module_guided}'='include' OR COALESCE(guided,0)=0)),
      a AS (SELECT module_id,COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) tried,

        a.n 动作次数,ROUND(1.0*a.user_days/NULLIF(a.tried,0),2) 人均使用天数,
        ROUND(100.0*a.rejected/NULLIF(a.n,0),1) 被拒率,ROUND(100.0*a.failed/NULLIF(a.n,0),1) 失败或放弃率,
        ROUND(t.seconds/60,1) 主动分钟,ROUND(t.seconds/60/NULLIF(t.players,0),1) 人均主动分钟,
        ROUND(100.0*t.seconds/NULLIF((SELECT s FROM total),0),1) 时长占比
      FROM x LEFT JOIN a USING(module_id) LEFT JOIN seen USING(module_id) LEFT JOIN t USING(module_id)
      ORDER BY 主动分钟 DESC NULLS LAST,x.sort

WITH m_raw AS (SELECT t.*,COALESCE(u.is_developer,0) is_developer FROM module_events t LEFT JOIN user_sessions u ON u.user_id=t.user_id WHERE 1 AND julianday(t.occurred_at) >= julianday(${__from}/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(t.occurred_at) < julianday(${__to}/1000,'unixepoch')), m AS (SELECT * FROM m_raw WHERE ('__all__' IN (${client_platform:sqlstring}) OR client_platform IN (${client_platform:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${release_version:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(NULLIF(release_version,''),'__empty__') IN (${release_version:sqlstring})) AND ('${test_data}'='include' OR ('${test_data}'='auto' AND (client_platform='editor' OR (is_development_build=0 AND is_developer=0))) OR ('${test_data}'='exclude' AND is_development_build=0 AND is_developer=0 AND client_platform!='editor') OR ('${test_data}'='only' AND (is_development_build=1 OR is_developer=1 OR client_platform='editor'))) AND ('${playtest_id}'='all' OR ('${playtest_id}'='legacy' AND (user_id,session_id) NOT IN (SELECT user_id,session_id FROM analytics_session_playtests)) OR (user_id,session_id) IN (SELECT user_id,session_id FROM analytics_session_playtests WHERE playtest_id='${playtest_id}')) AND ('__all__' IN (${distribution_channel:sqlstring}) OR (user_id,session_id) IN (SELECT user_id,session_id FROM analytics_session_channels WHERE distribution_channel IN (${distribution_channel:sqlstring})) OR ('unknown' IN (${distribution_channel:sqlstring}) AND (user_id,session_id) NOT IN (SELECT user_id,session_id FROM analytics_session_channels)))),
      acts AS (SELECT * FROM m WHERE is_player=1 AND COALESCE(source,'player') NOT IN ('cat','system','automatic','server_playback') AND event_type NOT IN ('offer_shown','currency_delta','ui_view_opened','ui_view_closed','feature_entry_exposed','theater_line','theater_view','restaurant_guest_ordered','restaurant_guest_left_angry','mail_arrived','visitor_wishes_appeared','restaurant_session_ended') AND ('${module_guided}'='include' OR COALESCE(guided,0)=0)),
      totals AS (SELECT module_id,COUNT(*) n FROM acts GROUP BY module_id)
      SELECT CASE module_id WHEN 'cat_chat' THEN '和猫聊天' WHEN 'theater' THEN '小剧场' WHEN 'ai_building' THEN 'AI 建筑/冒险' WHEN 'cat_petting' THEN '撸猫' WHEN 'cat_feeding' THEN '喂猫' WHEN 'cat_profile' THEN '猫档案' WHEN 'cat_house' THEN '猫舍/领养' WHEN 'fishing' THEN '钓鱼' WHEN 'farming' THEN '种田' WHEN 'restaurant' THEN '餐厅' WHEN 'bug_catching' THEN '捕虫' WHEN 'foraging' THEN '采集' WHEN 'shop' THEN '商店' WHEN 'vending' THEN '售货机' WHEN 'wardrobe' THEN '衣柜/换装' WHEN 'building' THEN '建造装饰' WHEN 'collection' THEN '图鉴/喵露册' WHEN 'research' THEN '研究' WHEN 'aquarium' THEN '水族馆' WHEN 'wish_star' THEN '许愿星' WHEN 'visitor_wish' THEN '访客愿望' WHEN 'mail_notes' THEN '信箱/留言' WHEN 'explore' THEN '地图/移动' WHEN 'progress' THEN '任务/成长' WHEN 'system' THEN '系统界面' WHEN 'unknown' THEN '未登记' WHEN 'free_roam' THEN '自由走动' ELSE module_id END 模块,action 动作,result 结果,COALESCE(reason,'未给原因') 原因,COUNT(*) 次数,COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) 人数,
        ROUND(100.0*COUNT(*)/MAX(t.n),1) 占该模块动作比例
      FROM acts JOIN totals t USING(module_id) WHERE result IN ('rejected','failed','cancelled')
      GROUP BY module_id,action,result,reason ORDER BY 次数 DESC LIMIT 200

WITH rf_raw AS (SELECT f.*,COALESCE(u.is_developer,0) is_developer FROM analytics_event_facts f LEFT JOIN user_sessions u ON u.user_id=f.user_id WHERE f.event_type IN ('restaurant_menu_changed','restaurant_session_started','cooking_completed') AND julianday(f.occurred_at) >= julianday(${__from}/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(f.occurred_at) < julianday(${__to}/1000,'unixepoch')), rf AS (SELECT * FROM rf_raw WHERE ('__all__' IN (${client_platform:sqlstring}) OR client_platform IN (${client_platform:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${release_version:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(NULLIF(release_version,''),'__empty__') IN (${release_version:sqlstring})) AND ('${test_data}'='include' OR ('${test_data}'='auto' AND (client_platform='editor' OR (is_development_build=0 AND is_developer=0))) OR ('${test_data}'='exclude' AND is_development_build=0 AND is_developer=0 AND client_platform!='editor') OR ('${test_data}'='only' AND (is_development_build=1 OR is_developer=1 OR client_platform='editor'))) AND ('${playtest_id}'='all' OR ('${playtest_id}'='legacy' AND (user_id,session_id) NOT IN (SELECT user_id,session_id FROM analytics_session_playtests)) OR (user_id,session_id) IN (SELECT user_id,session_id FROM analytics_session_playtests WHERE playtest_id='${playtest_id}')) AND ('__all__' IN (${distribution_channel:sqlstring}) OR (user_id,session_id) IN (SELECT user_id,session_id FROM analytics_session_channels WHERE distribution_channel IN (${distribution_channel:sqlstring})) OR ('unknown' IN (${distribution_channel:sqlstring}) AND (user_id,session_id) NOT IN (SELECT user_id,session_id FROM analytics_session_channels)))),
      menu AS (SELECT rf.user_id,CAST(json_extract(j.value,'$.recipe_id') AS INTEGER) recipe_id,json_extract(j.value,'$.count') servings
        FROM rf, json_each(rf.payload_json,'$.menu') j WHERE rf.event_type='restaurant_session_started'),
      cooked AS (SELECT user_id,CAST(json_extract(payload_json,'$.recipe_id') AS INTEGER) recipe_id,
        json_extract(payload_json,'$.dish_name') dish_name,json_extract(payload_json,'$.ordered') ordered FROM rf WHERE event_type='cooking_completed'),
      recipes AS (SELECT recipe_id FROM menu UNION SELECT recipe_id FROM cooked)
      SELECT r.recipe_id 菜谱ID,(SELECT MAX(dish_name) FROM cooked c WHERE c.recipe_id=r.recipe_id) 菜名,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM menu x WHERE x.recipe_id=r.recipe_id) 开店上架次数,
        (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM menu x WHERE x.recipe_id=r.recipe_id) 上架人数,
        (SELECT ROUND(AVG(servings),1) FROM menu x WHERE x.recipe_id=r.recipe_id) 平均上架份数,

        (SELECT SUM(ordered=0) FROM cooked c WHERE c.recipe_id=r.recipe_id) 没人点也做的份数
      FROM recipes r ORDER BY 开店上架次数 DESC,做出份数 DESC LIMIT 100
